name: clustercontrol-mcp
description: Connect Codex to the ClusterControl MCP server (cmon-mcp) to inspect, troubleshoot and operate the database clusters ClusterControl manages.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and operate ClusterControl database clusters.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the cmon-mcp service on your ClusterControl controller, so Codex can read cluster and node health, alarms, backups, jobs and configuration, and run guided procedures such as a daily fleet review. What Codex may change, and whether a change needs a person's approval, is set by the server on the controller.
defaultPrompt: Give me a daily review of my ClusterControl fleet.
Which clusters have open alarms, and what do they mean?
When did each cluster last complete a backup?
